concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-risk-management-chargeback-guidelines-pulse-chargebacks]] — Adyen PULSE chargeback guide (webpage snapshot, 2026-09-15) covering the default and fraud reason code 4868 flows, defense timing, qualified reversals, and route-specific finality.
warnings: Default-route Chargeback Reversed is qualified to reasons other than card-not-present fraud and can be followed by pre-arbitration and final second chargeback.

For reason code 4868, Chargeback Reversed follows a bank-accepted pre-arbitration and is final; a declined case remains Chargeback. Do not infer any fee schedule or current scheme eligibility from this snapshot.
